name: Fuel cells (PEM, SOFC)
principle: Fuel cells convert hydrogen to electricity electrochemically. PEM cells power vehicles and backup; solid oxide cells run at high temperature for stationary power. IEA rates PEM fuel cells for fuel cell vehicles at TRL 9 and solid oxide fuel cells at TRL 9. China's fuel cell truck stock reached almost 15,000 in 2024, up 40%, and fuel cell cars sold fewer than 100 units there that year.

process_steps.name: Hydrogen to anode, air to cathode

performance.basis: almost 15,000 in 2024, up 40% on 2023; China FCEV stock still short of its 50,000 target for 2025

source.note: IEA Global Hydrogen Review 2025 (collected in corpus/iea-reports): China fuel cell trucks

IEA ETP Clean Energy Technology Guide, dataset of 24 July 2026, latest assessment (IEA 1-11 scale): 'Polymer electrolyte membrane hydrogen fuel cell for FCEVs' 9 (2025); 'Solid oxide fuel cell' 9 (2025)

limitations: Far fewer fuel cell trucks than battery or CNG trucks in China (about 25 and 65 times as many)

sources.note: IEA Global Hydrogen Review 2025 (collected in corpus/iea-reports): fuel cell vehicle stock and sales in China, 2024
DOE Hydrogen Program Record 24004, Heavy-Duty Fuel Cell System Cost - 2023

costs.metric: HD PEM fuel cell system cost, 275 kWnet Class 8 long-haul truck
costs.basis: 2023-status next-generation laboratory technology on direct hydrogen at 50,000 systems/yr, 2016$; about USD 160/kWnet at 100,000 units/yr; Monte Carlo 90% confidence range USD 142-195/kW; 2022 status was USD 179/kWnet; DOE targets USD 140/kWnet (2025), 80 (2030) and 60 (ultimate)

source.note: DOE Hydrogen Program Record 24004, Heavy-Duty Fuel Cell System Cost - 2023, Item and Cost Results, Table 1 and Figures 2-3

costs.metric: stack share of HD fuel cell system cost
costs.basis: stack is circa 63% of the USD 168/kWnet 2023 system cost at 50,000 systems/yr, i.e. roughly USD 105/kWnet; catalyst is more than half the stack cost at high production volume

source.note: DOE Hydrogen Program Record 24004, Heavy-Duty Fuel Cell System Cost - 2023, Cost Results
